band_contract.easy: Observed direct inverse-tangent substitution with integer or radical inner factor.
band_contract.moderate: Observed nonunit constant normalization with u=x/a; include unit, cancelling, and independent numerators.
band_contract.hard: Authored canonical e-471 composition: both quadratic coefficients nonunit; factor the constant then use an independent integer or irrational substitution factor. No imported hard calibration.

sampling: Structural case first; independent positive exact coefficient roles. No global source-number substitution. Mathematical task deduplication across a batch.
limits: Finite bounded catalogs; count 1..100 is an input limit, not a guarantee of that many distinct tasks. Explicit exhaustion. Secant easy has a small integer matching-differential catalog.
